name: Shinjuku Rashoumon
source:
Set in modern day Shinjuku, where groups of individuals are out slaying demons that plague the town, following the way of the samurai. The era of Bakumatsu meets modern day Japan.

[From [url=https://yankeebanchou.wordpress.com/2022/01/08/2022-overview-upcoming-otome-josei-muke-bl-games/]Yankee Banchou[/url]]
